$comment: Scenario catalog for the neural speech provider. Every SDK runs it through its engine (IndeRun + ProviderRegistry) with the fixture runtime and the fixture audio output of ADR 021; the package under test is this file's 'package' (24000 Hz, pipeline 'fixture', voices 'v_de' (de-DE, de-AT) and 'v_en' (en-US)); text is 'Hallo Welt. Wie geht es dir?' (28 characters, 1400 ms with msPerCharacter: 50) unless the setup says otherwise; the profile is [neural, fallback] where 'fallback' is a scripted fake speech provider that records whether it was asked; every wait is bounded by 'timeoutMs'. 'setup' is normative prose and 'expect' is shared data; each SDK registers one handler per 'id' behind a guard test that fails when the handler ids and the ids here differ.

$expectKeys.commitCount: Whether the neural provider committed: 1 when the engine's provenance reports its attempt 'committed', else 0.
$expectKeys.commitAt: For a direct provider call with a spying commit(): 'sessionsOpened' and 'firstSessionWrites' at the moment commit() was called.
$expectKeys.sessions: How many audio output sessions the provider opened, and for the first: 'writes' (at least), 'stopped', 'discardedFrames' ('some' or 'none'), 'playedFrames' ('all' = every written frame played).
$expectKeys.fallbackAsked: Whether the second provider in the profile was asked to run.
$expectKeys.error: For 'error' outcomes and thrown refusals: 'errorClass' and 'code' (details.code).
$expectKeys.timing: 'durationMsEquals' ('synthesized' = frames / sampleRate * 1000), 'firstChunkDefined', 'firstAudioDefined'. firstChunkMs <= firstAudioMs holds on a real host, but the fixture audio output's virtual clock (advanced only by drain) cannot observe it, so it is not asserted here.
$expectKeys.order: For two utterances on one provider: 'secondOpensAfterFirstStops'.
$expectKeys.readiness: For capabilities_never_load: the readiness the capability check reports 'before' prepare ('cold') and 'after' it (null = absent).
$expectKeys.timeoutMs: Bounds every wait in the case (a sibling of 'expect' on each case).

cases.description: The provider commits after the audio output session is open and before the first write, and a normal playback ends with drain then stop.
cases.setup: Direct provider run in playback with a spying commit() that records how many fixture sessions are open and how many writes the first has at the moment it is called; await the result.

cases.description: A playback result reports chunk, first-audio and duration timings from one origin.
cases.setup: Same run as playback_commits_before_first_write; read the PlaybackTiming of the result.

cases.description: An utterance cancelled while it waits for the previous one holds its place and plays nothing.
cases.setup: Start speak A (text of 60 characters); start speak B; cancel B while A is still writing; await both. The expectation is for B; A completes (outcome completed) and is the only utterance that opens a session.

cases.description: Cancelling after commit stops the session once, discards buffered audio and stops consuming the runtime.
cases.setup: speak a text of 200 characters with the fixture runtime's delayMs: 5; cancel after the first write; await the terminal. Exactly one terminal event is delivered.

cases.description: A host without audioOutput makes the neural provider refuse before commit, so the fallback runs.
cases.setup: Host without audioOutput; speak with the profile [neural, fallback]. The neural commitCount, sessions and the first attempt's provenance rejection are the expectation.

cases.description: A bound voice that the package lacks is refused before commit.
cases.setup: Direct provider call with a bound voice { id: "ghost" }.

cases.description: An artifact run needs no audio output and returns a WAV of exactly the synthesized samples.
cases.setup: generateSpeech the text; read the artifact's bytes. 'dataBytes: 2*frames' and 'byteLengthEquals: wav' are computed from the frames the runtime produced.

cases.description: An artifact larger than the cap fails uncommitted and stops synthesis at the cap.
cases.setup: Single-provider profile; generateSpeech with msPerCharacter: 50000 and a 7-character text (350 s, 16.8 MB).

cases.description: An output interruption after commit is an error and is not retried on the fallback.
cases.setup: speak; after the first write the fixture session is interrupted with audio_output_interrupted.

cases.description: Two utterances on one provider never overlap.
cases.setup: Two speak calls started back to back on one provider; await both.

cases.description: Capability checks never load the runtime; only prepare does.
cases.setup: checkCapabilities twice, then prepare. Before prepare the runtime has had 0 prepare calls and readiness is cold; after, 1 prepare call and readiness is absent.
